candidates.review_note: Maximum multiset capacity of a trie node is min(c_node,left_capacity+right_capacity). Leaves have one assignment for each capacity0..k. If S is convolution of child capacity counts and total is child total assignments, count for capacity i is total^2-sum_{j<i}S[j]+(k-i)*S[i]: c=i allows childsum>=i, while c>i requires childsum=i. Root has no capacity and combines its two depth-n child distributions, so final coefficient f is a dot product. Truncate distributions above min(k,f), retaining exact full assignment total separately so discarded high capacities still contribute to min saturation. Exact polynomial convolution, prefix sums below2e14, and explicit f>2k zero. Check exhaustive small capacity assignments and all published samples including largest one.
